name: Order
description: A customer purchase as seen by an e-commerce platform or marketplace: identity, status, dates, monetary totals, customer and addresses, payment, line items, shipping/tracking, refunds and custom data. Shopify is covered only through the order-scoped fulfillment documents of the current build (no core order resource is indexed), so many Shopify mappings are partial.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Platform identifier of the order.

evidence.quote: Order's identifier

shopify.transform: Order id is the {order_id} used in the path; also exposed on each fulfillment order.

evidence.quote: Unique identifier of the order that contains this fulfillment order.
Unique identifier for the order.

fields.name: display_number
fields.description: Human-readable order number or name.

evidence.quote: Human-readable identifier or reference name of the order.
Sequential or formatted order number.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current lifecycle state of the order, in the platform's own vocabulary.

mirakl.transform: Map platform values to a canonical enum (mapping table not derivable from the evidence).

evidence.quote: Order's state

woocommerce.transform: Map platform values to a canonical enum (mapping table not derivable from the evidence).

evidence.quote: Current processing status of the order.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency code of the order amounts.

evidence.quote: Shop's currency (iso format)
Currency code used for the order amounts.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the order was created.

evidence.quote: Order's creation date

woocommerce.transform: Prefer the GMT variant; date_created is the site-local equivalent.

evidence.quote: Creation timestamp of the order in GMT.

fields.name: processed_at
fields.description: When the order was processed by the platform.

evidence.quote: Date and time when the order was originally processed.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the order was last modified.

evidence.quote: Last update date of the order
Last modification timestamp of the order in GMT.

fields.name: paid_at
fields.description: When payment for the order was recorded.

evidence.quote: The payment's date of the order by the customer
Timestamp when the payment was recorded, in GMT.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: When the order was marked complete.

evidence.quote: Timestamp when the order was marked complete, in GMT.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Grand total of the order.

evidence.quote: Order's total price (sum of the order price and the order shipping price)
Grand total charged for the order.

fields.name: items_subtotal
fields.description: Sum of the line prices, excluding shipping.

evidence.quote: Order's price (sum of order line price)

fields.name: shipping_total
fields.description: Total shipping charge of the order.

evidence.quote: Order's shipping price (sum of order line shipping price)
Total shipping cost for the order.

fields.name: discount_total
fields.description: Total discount applied to the order.

evidence.quote: Total amount of discounts applied to the order.

fields.name: tax_total
fields.description: Total tax on the order.

mirakl.transform: Sum the tax amounts of order_taxes[]; only present when order level tax calculation is enabled.

evidence.quote: Total amount of taxes aggregated per tax code and rate
Sum of all taxes applied across items and shipping.

fields.name: prices_include_tax
fields.description: Whether item prices already include tax.

mirakl.transform: true when order_tax_mode is TAX_INCLUDED, false when TAX_EXCLUDED.

evidence.quote: The tax mode is only useful if taxes are specified in the order.
Indicates whether item prices already include taxes.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order.

evidence.quote: Unique identifier of the customer.
Unique identifier of the registered customer who placed the order.

fields.name: customer_note
fields.description: Note left by the customer at checkout.

evidence.quote: Note or special instructions left by the customer during checkout.

fields.name: billing_address
fields.description: Billing address and contact details (name, company, street lines, city, state, postal code, country, phone, email where available).

mirakl.transform: billing_address.firstname/lastname/company/street_1/street_2/city/state/zip_code/country_iso_code/phone map to the canonical address parts.

evidence.quote: Billing address information for the customer.

woocommerce.transform: billing.first_name/last_name/address_1/address_2/city/state/postcode/country/email/phone map to the canonical address parts.

evidence.quote: Billing address and contact details for the order.

fields.name: shipping_address
fields.description: Delivery address and recipient details.

mirakl.transform: shipping_address.firstname/lastname/company/street_1/street_2/city/state/zip_code/country_iso_code/phone map to the canonical address parts.

evidence.quote: Shipping address information for delivery to the customer.

shopify.transform: destination.first_name/last_name/company/address1/address2/city/province/zip/country/phone/email map to the canonical address parts; one destination per fulfillment order.

evidence.quote: Destination address and contact details where the fulfillment order items will be shipped.

woocommerce.transform: shipping.first_name/last_name/address_1/address_2/city/state/postcode/country map to the canonical address parts.

evidence.quote: Shipping address details for delivery.

fields.name: payment_method
fields.description: Payment method used for the order.

evidence.quote: Payment's type used by the customer to pay this order
Unique slug of the payment gateway used for the order.

fields.name: payment_transaction_id
fields.description: Reference of the payment transaction.

evidence.quote: Payment's transaction number
Reference identifier assigned by the payment provider.

fields.name: line_items
fields.description: Ordered items.

evidence.quote: Order lines

shopify.transform: Union of fulfillment.line_items[] across the order's fulfillments (covers fulfilled items only).

evidence.quote: List of line items included in this fulfillment.
List of products and quantities included in the order.

fields.name: line_items[].quantity
fields.description: Units ordered for the line.

evidence.quote: Number of units ordered.

shopify.transform: Quantity fulfilled, not necessarily quantity ordered.

evidence.quote: Number of units fulfilled for this line item.
Number of units of the product to order.

fields.name: line_items[].sku
fields.description: Seller SKU of the ordered item.

evidence.quote: Seller SKU of the offer.
Stock keeping unit identifier for the item.

fields.name: line_items[].product_ref
fields.description: Identifier of the product (or variant) behind the line.

evidence.quote: Marketplace product SKU.
Unique identifier of the parent product.
Unique identifier of the product being purchased.

fields.name: line_items[].title
fields.description: Display name of the ordered item.

evidence.quote: Title or name of the product.
Title of the product.

fields.name: line_items[].unit_price
fields.description: Price of one unit.

evidence.quote: Unit price of the product.
Price charged per unit before discounts.

fields.name: line_items[].line_total
fields.description: Total price of the line, excluding shipping.

evidence.quote: Total price of the items in the order line, excluding shipping.

fields.name: line_items[].discount_total
fields.description: Discount applied to the line.

evidence.quote: Total discount amount applied across all units of this line item.

fields.name: line_items[].status
fields.description: State of the individual line.

evidence.quote: Order line's state
Fulfillment state of this specific line item within the order.

fields.name: shipping_method
fields.description: Shipping method or type chosen for the order.

evidence.quote: Label of shipping's type

woocommerce.transform: Take shipping_lines[]; an order may have several shipping lines.

evidence.quote: Display label for the selected shipping method.

fields.name: shipment_carrier
fields.description: Carrier handling the shipment.

evidence.quote: Shipping company
The name of the shipping carrier handling the package.

fields.name: tracking_number
fields.description: Carrier tracking number.

evidence.quote: Shipping tracking

shopify.transform: One value per fulfillment; tracking_numbers[] lists all.

evidence.quote: The tracking number assigned to the shipment.

fields.name: tracking_url
fields.description: URL to follow the shipment.

evidence.quote: Shipping tracking url
The web URL to track the shipment with the carrier.

fields.name: fulfillments
fields.description: Shipments/fulfillments of the order.

evidence.quote: A list of fulfillments associated with the order.

fields.name: refunds
fields.description: Refunds issued against the order.

mirakl.transform: Only populated when order level tax calculation is enabled; line-level refunds live under order_lines[].

evidence.quote: The list of refunds aggregated by group identifier
List of refunds issued against the order.

fields.name: discounts
fields.description: Coupons, promotions or discount campaigns applied.

evidence.quote: Promotions' summary applied to the order
Coupons applied to discount the order.

fields.name: sales_channel
fields.description: Channel where the order originated.

evidence.quote: The channel of the commercial's order
Unique identifier of the sales channel where the order originated.

fields.name: custom_fields
fields.description: Merchant-defined key/value data on the order.

evidence.quote: Order's custom fields
List of custom metadata key-value pairs attached to the order.

fields.name: marketplace_commission
fields.description: Commission retained by the marketplace on the order (marketplace-only concept).

evidence.quote: Order's total commission (sum of the order line total commission)

openQuestions.question: Shopify has no core order resource in this build (only order-scoped fulfillment, fulfillment-order, event and transaction-count documents). Should Shopify order-level fields (totals, status, customer, billing address, currency) be filled from a later build or another document set?
options: wait for an indexed Orders resource

openQuestions.question: Is total tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive in each API? WooCommerce exposes prices_include_tax; Mirakl exposes order_tax_mode, and its total_price is documented as order price plus shipping price.
Mirakl has both order_id and commercial_id (a commercial order can group several seller orders). Which one is the canonical order identity?
Shopify fulfillment_orders[].order_processed_at is mapped to processed_at, not created_at. Is it equivalent to creation time?
Status vocabularies differ (WooCommerce status vs Mirakl order_state) and the evidence gives no mapping; Shopify fulfillment status is not an order status. What canonical status enum should be used?
Mirakl is a multi-seller marketplace and WooCommerce/Shopify are single-merchant stores; is an Order one seller's order (Mirakl order_id) or the customer's whole purchase?
